## 2. Product Line & Specifications

### 2.1 BROSKI Non-Veg Dog Biscuits (Chicken Bone)
- **Net Weight:** 400 grams
- **SKU:** BR-NV-400G
- **MRP:** ₹149 (Inclusive of all taxes)
- **Biscuit Shape:** Classic bone shape
- **Key Ingredients:** Whole wheat flour, bone broth, liver extract, vegetable oil, essential vitamins and minerals.
- **Packaging:** Premium yellow stand-up barrier pouch with transparent product viewing window, heat seal, and resealable press-to-close zip.
- **Feeding Recommendation:**
  - Small dogs (< 10 kg): 2–4 biscuits per day
  - Medium dogs (10–25 kg): 4–8 biscuits per day
  - Large dogs (> 25 kg): 8–12 biscuits per day
  - Fresh drinking water should always be available.

### 2.2 BROSKI Mix Flavour Dog Biscuits
- **Net Weight:** 400 grams
- **SKU:** BR-MX-400G
- **MRP:** ₹179 (Inclusive of all taxes)
- **Biscuit Shape:** Bone shape (multi-colour trio)
- **Key Ingredients:** Whole wheat flour, milk solids, vegetable extracts, savory poultry broth, natural permitted colours, minerals.
- **Packaging:** Premium yellow stand-up barrier pouch with transparent product window and resealable zip.

### 2.3 BROSKI Peanut Butter Dog Biscuits
- **Net Weight:** 400 grams
- **SKU:** BR-PB-400G
- **MRP:** ₹179 (Inclusive of all taxes)
- **Biscuit Shape:** Bone shape
- **Key Ingredients:** Whole wheat flour, roasted peanut butter (xylitol-free), oats, vegetable oil, natural tocopherols.
- **Packaging:** Premium yellow stand-up barrier pouch with transparent product window and resealable zip.

### 2.4 Pilot Sampler Pouches (50g)
- **Net Weight:** 50 grams (approx. 5–6 biscuits)
- **Purpose:** Distributed free or at nominal ₹20 cost during Delhi neighborhood sampling drives to allow dogs to taste-test before owners purchase full 400g pouches.
- **Interactive QR Code:** Directs to https://broskipetfood.com/r/ for feedback submission and repeat-order discount codes.

---

## 3. Distribution, Logistics & Wholesale
- **Target Territory (Pilot Phase):** West Delhi clusters: Nangloi, Paschim Vihar, Janakpuri, Rajouri Garden, Punjabi Bagh, Dwarka.
- **Retailer Terms:** Wholesale case packs (12 or 24 pouches per corrugated master carton) with healthy retailer margins, free promotional counter displays, and window-sticker sample dispensers.
- **Direct-to-Consumer:** Orders placed via WhatsApp or website are packed fresh in Nangloi and dispatched via local courier partners across Delhi NCR within 24–48 hours.
